build.rationale: Creates or rebuilds a Docker node image locally; modifies Docker state but is bounded and reversible.

create.rationale: Creates a local Kubernetes cluster using Docker containers; modifies state but is expected, bounded, and reversible via delete.

delete.rationale: Destroys Kubernetes cluster infrastructure irreversibly; high-blast-radius deletion operation.

export.rationale: Exports kubeconfig and logs; only reads and copies existing data without modification.

get.rationale: Lists clusters, nodes, and retrieves kubeconfig; all read-only inspection operations.

load.rationale: Loads Docker images into cluster nodes; modifies cluster state but is bounded and reversible.
